messages:
sara_support: Escalating Sunrise Health onboarding to CS. Customer acct SH-9001, ARR ~$340k. Onboarding stuck at schema validation step and 422 payload errors. They've reported timeouts and token errors intermittently. Renewal check in 18 days. Need urgent CS takeover + comms plan.

leo_cs: Thanks Sara, on it. Can you post the last 2 error samples and whether support saw any traffic pattern spikes? We'll prepare a 30m bridge and include eng.

sara_support: Error snippets: 
```
2026-04-02T09:12:03Z WARN http: 422 validation_error field=record[patients].dob reason="invalid_date"
2026-04-02T09:12:15Z ERROR auth: token exchange failed id=SH-9001 code=401 detail="expired_refresh_token"
```
We also saw a small spike in concurrent uploads starting 09:10Z (approx +3x normal).

ops-bot: [incident] P1 created: INC-2026-204 assigned to customer-success. SLA initial contact: 2 business hours.

marta_csm: Proposed comms: 1) immediate 20min triage call to unblock ingestion, 2) shared status message to customer within 1hr, 3) internal note to renewals with mitigation plan if unresolved. I'll draft the status blurb.

devon_se: Initial hypothesis: client-side schema drift (dob format) plus refresh token expiry. Short-term fixes: provide a strict schema sample + ask them to refresh credentials (we can issue a new client secret via admin API). I can join call to validate sample payloads.

leo_cs: Schedule: triage call at 10:30 PT (in 40m). Marta will host. @devon_se please be ready for live walkthrough of payload. @sara_support attach full logs to INC-2026-204 and set org debug for 12h.

sara_support: Done: attached logs and enabled debug mode: `enable_org_debug SH-9001 --ttl=12h`. Also reached out to engineering to request a one-time client secret rotate if needed.

marta_csm: Draft status to customer (short):
"Hi Tomas, we saw two causes: a schema mismatch for dob and an expired integration token. We're scheduling a 20m troubleshooting call at 10:30 PT to walk through a corrected payload and rotate your integration key if needed. We'll apply a temporary ingest throttle change to absorb the spike. More after the call. — Marta, CSM"

devon_se: During call we can do a canary rotate: create a new client secret, update a single test workspace, confirm success, then complete rotation. If they prefer, we can also accept a rolling format change to dob (ISO vs MM/DD/YYYY) and provide a validation script.

leo_cs: After call update: performed canary rotate, test workspace accepted new secret, ingests for test workspace succeeded. Applied short-term throttle limit change to reduce concurrency from 50 -> 20 for SH-9001. Customer reported reduced error rate.

marta_csm: Next steps: 1) monitor for 72h (CS will watch health dashboards), 2) send follow-up with validation script and schema sample, 3) schedule a hardening session with their engineering next week. I'll also alert renewals: include note that customer is stable but on-watch; propose an outreach cadence.

sara_support: Marking INC-2026-204 as P1 and pinged sales-rep for the account re: renewal timing and possible short-term concession ask.

leo_cs: Quick FYI: we flagged this as potential churn risk if multiple outages in onboarding. Recommend renewals prep a 1:1 touch if errors reappear.

marta_csm: Update (post-call): customer accepted canary rotation and the temporary throttle. Errors dropped from ~40% -> <2% for restarted jobs. Monitoring continues. I'll close this thread once dashboards show stable for 72h and post a short root-cause summary into INC-2026-204.
